name: ConsentX
description: 1-click cookie consent banner with Google Consent Mode v2 and pre-consent script blocking.
project_description:
ConsentX Cookie Consent & Compliance 
 
ConsentX is a modern Consent Management Platform (CMP) for Drupal that enables websites to deploy a fully featured cookie consent banner, implement Google Consent Mode v2, and help comply with global privacy regulations including GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, DPDPA, and more.

 Features 
 
 One-click ConsentX account connection 
 Cookie Consent Banner 
 Google Consent Mode v2 support 
 Automatic Cookie Scanning 
 Pre-consent Script Blocking 
 Geo-aware Compliance Rules 
 Consent Analytics Dashboard 
 Consent Logging 
 Easy Administration 
 Automatic Website Registration 
 Customizable Banner Appearance 
 Automatic Consent Synchronization 
 Supports multiple privacy regulations 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 9, 10 or 11 
 A ConsentX account 
 Internet connection to communicate with ConsentX services 
 
 Installation 
 
 Install the ConsentX module. 
 Enable the module. 
 Connect your ConsentX account from the module settings. 
 Your website is automatically registered with ConsentX. 
 The cookie consent banner becomes active immediately. 
 
 Documentation 
 
Complete installation and configuration guides are available at:

 https://docs.consentx.io 

 Support 
 
Website:

 https://www.consentx.io 

 
Documentation:

 https://docs.consentx.io 

 Privacy Regulations Supported 
 
 GDPR 
 UK GDPR 
 CCPA / CPRA 
 LGPD 
 DPDPA (India) 
 PIPEDA 
 POPIA 
 And additional regional privacy regulations. 
 
 Why ConsentX? 
 
 Easy setup in minutes 
 Automatic compliance updates 
 Google Consent Mode v2 ready 
 Designed for Drupal websites 
 Modern cloud-based consent management platform
